title: Integra Visual Source Catalog
policy: This is a discovery catalog, not a verified live-site index.
Every source starts as catalog-only until a specific page or section is inspected.
Choose sources to answer a concrete design question; popularity is not authority.
Check current URLs, plan access, licences and API requirements at the point of use.
Extract transferable principles; do not copy protected layouts, text, code, brand assets or complete compositions.
